nodes.note: Tanner's Row, three wide with a verge on its south side and its lamps on the verge.

The new smithy: roofed, walled on three sides, its street side open. Behind the open front's first row, which the row's crossing keeps clear, a frame of posts and a beam stands where the wall would have been, its counter under the beam and its door in the frame under the same head. The forge and the anvil behind.
The fountain square, open on every side. In its middle a fountain: water raised in a bowl on a stack over a basin round it.

The old stall: roofed, walled on three sides, its street side open. Behind the open front's first row a one-course counter and a two-course door stand side by side with nothing over them under the five-course void.
The old well-yard, open on every side, a flat ring of stone round one cell of water at the ring's own height.
The warden's lodge across the row, walled all round, its doorway on the row.
